title: NoSQL & MongoDB
intro: NoSQL and MongoDB interviews test whether you understand the document model and when to choose it over relational. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with NoSQL fundamentals (the CAP trade-off, the four NoSQL families), then MongoDB core (the document, the collection, the BSON), then the document model (embedding vs referencing). Indexes and Elasticsearch follow at the mechanics tier, then Spring Data MongoDB at the code tier. NoSQL patterns close the applied tier, then comparisons and scenario-based questions.
